AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Taiwan Ebook Search compares ebook prices across Taiwan stores by book title or ISBN. Operational Patterns: - Use searchBooks for a live title or ISBN comparison. - Use getSearchSnapshot only with a searchId returned by searchBooks. That reloads the saved result and does not search again. - Use getRecentSearchRecords to read the newest local search strings on this device. This is personal history, not a bookshelf. - Use openBookProduct only with a product URL already returned by this app. That opens or shares the link. It is not checkout. Constraints: - Supported queries are book title or ISBN only. - This app does not purchase, log in, delete history, scan barcodes, or manage a bookshelf. - Prices are not currency-converted. Unknown prices are not free. - Opening a product URL is not checkout. - getRecentSearchRecords returns at most 20 local records. - There is no ping or health-check function.
